source.surface: chat rail plus document pane, whole-document rewrite pending with the affected region highlighted
source.attribution: Flow curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screens.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: not visible as a labelled button on the observed screens; the pending operation is headed by a restated instruction pill with a submit arrow
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: not observed — recorded as unknown rather than guessed
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: not observed — recorded as unknown rather than guessed
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: every line of the document body, including the table cells, is covered by a single pale violet highlight band; the highlight spans the entire scope the operation will touch
decisionColour.postAcceptTreatment: the violet highlight is removed entirely and the rewritten document is set in ordinary body colour
decisionColour.verdict: This is the one observed reference where the undecided CONTAINER is tinted rather than only a button. Crucially the tint is violet, a scope marker, and is not the hue any accept control uses anywhere in the product. The container colour answers 'what will be changed', not 'has this been approved'.
